name: Craig Wheel
source:
He was born into the famous music family of Wheel and brought up to be a pianist, making him  exceptionally talented. He is childhood friends with Lon.

Always practices the piano until late, so he is always sleepy during the day. He majors in music at school and hates mathematics.

His father expects them to enroll at the top music academy, Moriland, but this is something painful for him. Everyone in the family performs outstandingly, and that's why Craig always feels a lot of pressure. He hopes one day he can stand on stage without fear.

[Edited from in-game bio]
